epics.title: Self-Falsification Improvement Patch
epics.jtbd: When the development team reviews past work, I want to resolve the confirmed structural and procedural findings, so that the codebase remains fully compliant with required invariant standards.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unresolved audit findings from 8 to 0
requirements: R1: Revert generated file changes, enforce measurable baselines, and fix Flyway script column types and error masking.

slices.title: Apply Self-Falsification Corrections
slices.jtbd: When implementing the audit corrections for this epic, I want to patch the repository directly, so that all eight findings are resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given task plans in PRs 18 and 20, When patched, Then they include a measurable starting baseline and correct domain alignment.
Given the Flyway script in PR 19, When revised, Then it uses TIMESTAMPTZ, gen_random_uuid(), and resolves the root cause instead of using IF NOT EXISTS.
Given the backend endpoints in PR 21, When verified, Then proper test files and contract tests are added and generated reports from PR 22 are reverted.
Given the need for quality assurance, When the patches are applied, Then the existing test suite executes successfully covering these changes.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce failing invariance checks from 8 to 0
